interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk to provide a continuous, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Corner Daylighting
interventions.description: Ensure the corner remains clear of obstructions to improve sightlines for all road users.
